findings.note: MA House, On adoption of amendment #7 (H.4359) - failed, 2022-01-27: nay (tally 32–126); census gate: none.

He filed H.565, An Act relative to absentee ballots, described as legislation to further regulate absentee voting. The text lets people employed by a city or town on election day, in running a primary or election, apply for and return an absentee ballot as if they were away from town. It sets no ID or citizenship rule. Referred to the Election Laws committee on 2015-01-20.
